quote.text: In the morning, when you rise unwillingly, let this thought be present: I am rising to the work of a human being. Why then am I dissatisfied if I am going to do the things for which I exist and for which I was brought into the world? Or have I been made for this, to lie under the blankets and keep myself warm? But this is more pleasant. Do you exist then to take your pleasure, and not at all for action or exertion?
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace each day as a fresh opportunity to nurture and guide your children, recognizing that your efforts, however small they seem, contribute to a greater human purpose.
    • Remember that the act of caring and teaching is an essential duty, much like rising each morning to fulfill your role—it's not merely about comfort, but about fostering growth and character in both you and your children.
  • Leadership
    • Rise with the awareness that as a leader, you are entrusted with the responsibility to inspire, guide, and work diligently, even when the task ahead may seem daunting.
    • Understand that true leadership thrives on action and exertion—by facing each day’s challenges with purpose, you set a moral example that motivates others to follow suit.
  • Product Management
    • Approach your role with the determination to engage with every problem and opportunity head-on, acknowledging that daily efforts contribute to the success and evolution of your product.
    • Recognize that, like the intrinsic duty to rise and work, product management requires perseverance and purpose—each decision propels you towards creating value for users and stakeholders alike.
